journey.name: lightning fee review
journey.description: Verifies that fixed-amount Lightning invoices and Paykit requests show an available numeric routing-fee estimate before payment approval. Preconditions: two owned regtest wallets linked as contacts, usable Spending channels with a nonzero route fee, and QuickPay disabled on the sending wallet. Keep both apps running. Review and cancel each payment without submitting it.

actions.action: On the receiving wallet, create a fresh 1,000-sat Lightning invoice from Receive and copy its complete invoice
Open that invoice on the sending wallet with a lightning: deep link
Verify confirmation shows 1,000 sats without requiring amount entry
Open Show Details and verify Spending, the recipient invoice and a numeric estimated fee
Dismiss the send review without swiping to pay and verify no outgoing payment was created
On the receiving wallet, create a fresh 1,000-sat payment request for the sending contact with Spending as its only accepted payment method
On the sending wallet, open the received payment request and tap Pay if it has not opened automatically
Open Show Details and verify confirmation shows 1,000 sats, Spending, the receiving contact and a numeric estimated fee
Dismiss the send review without swiping to pay and verify the request remains unpaid
